sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.
This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No. 295 of 2021, under section 420 IPC, Police Station- Govind Nagar, District- Mathura.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The offences said to be committed by the applicant are punishable with sentence less than seven years, therefore, direction be made to the learned court to dispose of Sunil Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31507621/
1 the bail application in the light of case decided by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2022 SC 577 decided on 11.07.2022.
On the other hand, learned AGA opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail.
